title: MiniQMT strategy ledger does not apply SELL fills to lots cash and realized PnL
description:
Expected: When MiniQMT SELL fills are synchronized, AIstock must match the fill to the owning strategy intent, close strategy position lots using a deterministic policy such as FIFO, decrease remaining/available quantities, append SELL_FILL cash ledger entries, update virtual account cash, realized_pnl, market_value, unrealized_pnl, and keep the operation idempotent across repeated syncs.
Actual: QmtStrategyLedgerSyncService only creates PositionLotRecord rows for BUY fills. There is no SELL branch that consumes existing lots, no SELL_FILL cash entry, no realized PnL calculation, and no virtual account valuation refresh. Therefore after BUG-050 begins generating SELL intents, filled sells can be recorded in trade_ledger but strategy lot/cash/PnL state will remain incorrect.
required_verification: Unit test: full SELL fill closes FIFO lots and appends exactly one SELL_FILL cash ledger entry.
Unit test: partial SELL fill partially closes lots, leaves remaining_quantity correct, and records realized_pnl.
Unit test: repeated sync of the same SELL trade is idempotent and does not double-count cash or PnL.
Unit test: same-symbol multi-strategy sell only closes lots owned by the selling strategy intent/order_remark.
Integration check: strategy summary cash, market_value, realized_pnl, unrealized_pnl, and total_equity match lots after SELL fills.
closure_requirements: SELL fills update position_lot remaining/available quantities and lifecycle status.
SELL fills update strategy cash ledger and virtual account realized PnL exactly once.
Lot closure policy is deterministic and auditable from trade_ledger/order_intent/order_remark.
BUY and SELL settlement tests both pass together so per-strategy returns are trustworthy.

events.note: Root cause hypothesis: sync_service.py handles trade insertion and BUY lot creation only; SELL fill accounting is not implemented although CashEntryType.SELL_FILL exists.
Business impact: P0 because a strategy that can sell must have correct realized PnL/cash/lot closure; otherwise per-strategy returns and further position sizing are wrong.
This is related to BUG-049 but should remain separate: BUG-049 covers BUY fill settlement/frozen cash/market value; this issue covers SELL fill settlement and lot closure.
Required verification: full SELL fill closes FIFO lots, partial SELL fill partially closes lots, repeated sync is idempotent, and SELL fill creates auditable cash/PnL entries exactly once.
Required verification: same-symbol multi-strategy sells only close lots owned by the selling strategy intent/order_remark.
Expanded from miniQMT issue coverage audit with explicit verification and closure requirements before code fixes.
Mirrored BUG-052 to GitHub issue #55 via gh CLI from miniQMT issue coverage audit.
Confirmed GitHub issue #55 is OPEN and label-synced (bug, status:open, P0, severity:p0, module:qmt_strategy_ledger, risk:trading_ledger_correctness) before fix worktree creation.
